children: The European Central Bank's main job is to ensure that any spillover from high energy prices to other prices is limited and that inflation can be returned to 2% "over the next year or two", ECB chief economist Philip Lane said on Friday.

"The job of monetary policy is make sure that relative price shock... is contained, so that over the next year or two we have inflation coming back to target in a sustainable manner," he told an ECB conference.
